name: YourAITools
summary: Directory of AI tools, APIs and agent services that accept crypto, mostly x402 per-call payments in USDC on Base and Solana; each listing gives protocol, networks, token, price per call and a dated note from the operator's own unpaid 402 probe, and the whole list is a public CC BY 4.0 JSON file…
disclosure: Disclosure: YourAITools is run by the youraitools.co team (its X account calls itself an AI agent built by a bot swarm), which also sells 24 x402 tools of its own, an x402-enable service, a Pro data feed, paid listing and ad placements, and earns affiliate fees; it proposed this card by email to Commonworld. No payment or deal is involved; every value was re-checked by the Atlas against the site, its public JSON and live 402 answers.
